The ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**. I posted that as a reply to Tobias's message in #central-random.

It comes from Hollis's message in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, which says the import is attached to PD-4821. Tobias is in that channel, so they could already see it. That needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.

I only have that channel message to go on. The shared file area has no ticket files, so I couldn't check the ticket itself or its current status.
